sentences.text:
This Civil Miscellaneous Appeal has been filed Challenging the award passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Special Sub Court I, Salem, made in M.C.O.P.No.343 of 2023 dated 13.08.2024.
2.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The appellant/claimant filed a claim petition under Section 166 of M.V. Act, claiming compensation of Rs.50,00,000/- for the injuries caused him in the road accident on 21.11.2022.
3. The learned Tribunal after hearing both sides and upon considering the oral and documentary evidence has granted compensation Rs.11,53,788/- in the following manner:-

3. For Transportation   4. For Nourishments   5. For attendant charges
6 . For Damages and cloth  https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
Sl . No Description
7 . For loss of amenities   8. Permanent disability

Total  4. The Tribunal directed the above compensation to be paid by the 2nd respondent with interest at the rate of 7.5% p.a.
5. The appellant/claimant, not being satisfied with the quantum of compensation awarded by the Tribunal,, has filed this appeal seeking enhancement of compensation.
6. The learned counsel for the appellant submitted that the accident was happened in the year 2022 but the Tribunal without considering the cost of living in the year, passed the award as such is erroneous one.
He further submitted that the award passed by the Tribunal under all the heads is lower, which requires interference by this Court and prays to allow this appeal.

8. In the instant case, the Injured person is a student and the accident was happened in the year 2022, considering the cost of living at that time of accident 2022, this Court is enhanced the amount with regard to disability at Rs.2,43,000/-, for pain and suffering at Rs.75,000/-
In other aspects, the amount awarded by the Tribunal appears to be reasonable.

In the result, this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is allowed in part and the compensation awarded by the Tribunal at Rs.11,53,788/- is hereby enhanced to Rs.12,32,788/- together with interest @ 7.5%
per annum from the date of filing of claim petition till the date of deposit.

The 2nd respondent is directed to deposit the entire award amount now determined by this Court along with interest, less the amount already deposited, if any, within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this Judgment, to the credit of MCOP.No.343 of 2023 on the file of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Special Sub Court I, Salem.
